headline: Bolt Multiplier joins the mod index for Ratchet & Clank
summary: Bolt Multiplier joined the mod index through #191. Its submission describes earning up to x20 bolts by defeating enemies without taking damage in Ratchet & Clank, with multiplied crate rewards, configurable activation and an in-game counter (#190). Versions 0.2.4 (#193) and 0.3.0 (#194) await review before players receive those updates.
highlights: #192 proposes saving the real inventory during randomized NPC rewards in both the randomizer and Archipelago, including Helga's autosave and nested saves. It has not merged.
